units.source_text: 源氏公子教把前驱的火把遮暗些，勿使惹人注目，悄悄地离开了乳母家。

en.t: Prince Genji had the torches of his outriders dimmed so as not to draw attention, and quietly left his nurse's house.

units.source_text: 邻家的吊窗已经关上，窗缝里漏出来的灯光，比萤火还幽暗，看了很可怜。

en.t: The hanging window of the neighboring house was already shut, and the light leaking through its cracks was dimmer than fireflies, a pitiful sight.

units.source_text: 来到了目的地六条的邸宅里，看见树木花草皆与别处不同，住处安排得优雅娴静。

en.t: When he arrived at his destination, the Rokujo residence, he saw that the trees, flowers, and grasses were unlike those elsewhere, and the dwelling was arranged with quiet elegance.

units.source_text: 六条妃子品貌端庄秀丽，更非一般女子可比。

en.t: Lady Rokujo was dignified and beautiful in both character and appearance, far beyond comparison with ordinary women.

units.source_text: 公子到此，便把墙根夕颜之事忘记了。

en.t: Once the prince arrived there, he forgot all about the evening faces by the wall.

units.source_text: 次日起身略迟，到了日上三竿之时，方始动身。

en.t: The next day he rose rather late, and only set out after the sun was already high.

units.source_text: 他那容姿映着晨光，异常优美，外人对他的称誉确是名副其实的。

en.t: His figure, touched by the morning light, was extraordinarily beautiful, and the praise people gave him was truly deserved.

units.source_text: 今天归途又经过那夕颜花的窗前。

en.t: On his way back that day, he again passed before the window with the evening face flowers.

units.source_text: 往常赴六条时，屡屡经过此地，却一向不曾注意。

en.t: In the past, when going to Rokujo, he had often passed this place, but had never paid it any attention.

units.source_text: 只为了扇上题诗那件小事，

en.t: Only because of that small matter of the poem written on the fan,

units.source_text: 从此牵惹了公子的心目，他想：“这里面住的毕竟是怎样的人呢？”

en.t: from then on it caught the prince's heart and eye, and he wondered, "What kind of person could be living in there?"

units.source_text: 此后每逢赴六条，往返经过其地，必然注目细看。

en.t: After that, whenever he went to Rokujo and passed the place on the way there or back, he always looked at it closely.
